_comment: Recorded entity-metadata snapshot (WP-3b.3c, D-036). The offline stand-in for the Get endpoint's result.properties[] — PascalCase paths as the backend spells them; the compiler emits the camelCased binding. verify.mjs auto-loads <screen>.metadata.json so the T3 backend checks resolve without a live backend; a screen with no snapshot leaves those checks uninspectable (partial), never a pass.
